items.title: UAE real GDP edges up 0.4% in H1 2026; construction grows 5.1%, real estate 2.3%
items.summary: Preliminary FCSC data put UAE real GDP at Dh961.9bn ($262bn) in H1 2026, up 0.4% year on year, though Q2 output fell 2.1% amid regional disruption. Non-oil GDP rose 1.8% to a 79.2% share; finance grew 14.8%, construction 5.1% and real estate 2.3%.

items.title: Nakheel awards marine contract to upgrade 3km of Dubai Islands shoreline by Q4 2027
items.summary: Nakheel has appointed Mar Marine & Building Contracting to build breakwaters and a 320m beach near the 636-home Bay Villas on Dubai Islands' Island B and upgrade about 3km of its western shoreline. Completion is due in Q4 2027; the contract value was not disclosed.

items.title: Dubai home sales fall 47% to Dh72.6bn in Q3; S&P estimates prices down 5–15%
items.summary: Cavendish Maxwell data show Dubai home sales of Dh72.6bn across 34,000 deals in Q3 2026, down 47% and 38% year on year; off-plan made up 72% of purchases. S&P estimates prices fell 5–15% between end-2025 and September and expects a gradual correction led by apartments.

items.title: Dubai permits shared housing in 44-plus areas and sets 5 sq m minimum per occupant
items.summary: Dubai Municipality has issued planning and building rules under Law No. 4 of 2026, permitting shared housing in more than 44 areas including Al Barsha 1, Al Rigga and Al Warqa 1. Bedrooms need at least 5 sq m per occupant and buildings need permits; existing stock has a year from 8 September to comply.

items.title: Jeddah Tower passes 116 of 157 floors; completion now targeted for late 2028
items.summary: Jeddah Economic Company's planned 1,008m Jeddah Tower has reached floor 116 of 157, about 466m high, with completion now targeted for late 2028 amid rising procurement and construction costs. Apartment sales are due to start in 2027. Saudi Binladin Group is building it under a SAR7.2bn contract.

items.title: Diriyah Company awards $728m contracts for Diriyah Square hotels and residences
items.summary: Diriyah Company has awarded two construction contracts worth SAR2.73bn ($727.9m) at Diriyah Square: SAR1.32bn to a MAN–MAG joint venture and SAR1.41bn to Urbacon Saudi. The works cover luxury hotels and branded residences totalling 413 hotel rooms and 34 residential units.

items.title: Mnzil, TDG and Capital Partners launch SAR1bn Saudi workforce housing fund
items.summary: Mnzil, The Development Group and Capital Partners have launched a SAR1bn ($267m) real estate fund to build purpose-built housing for up to 50,000 workers in Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, Khobar, Makkah and Madinah. Development is expected to begin in Q4 2026, with Mnzil as exclusive operator.

items.title: Eagle Hills signs framework deal for Damascus towers and Latakia resort in Syria
items.summary: Abu Dhabi's Eagle Hills has signed a framework agreement with Syria's housing and tourism ministries to develop the Tadamun Towers residential scheme in Damascus and the Eco Life tourism project in Latakia. Values were not disclosed; state media said the projects would create more than 40,000 jobs.

items.title: Dubai CommerCity to add 91,000 sq m of offices in Dh1.8bn second-phase expansion
items.summary: Dubai CommerCity, the DIEZ–Wasl digital commerce free zone, is investing Dh1.8bn in a second expansion phase adding more than 91,000 sq m of offices across six buildings and a 5,600 sq m logistics facility, The Hive. Delivery runs from Q1 2027 to Q4 2028; existing space is nearly 96% occupied.

items.title: Mubadala leads Gulf sovereign funds with $26.2bn deployed in nine months
items.summary: Global SWF data show MENA sovereign investors deployed $102bn across 245 deals in January–September 2026, 39% of global state-owned dealmaking. Mubadala led with $26.2bn, ahead of PIF ($14bn), ADIA ($12.2bn), L'imad ($10.8bn) and QIA ($10.3bn). Real estate took 11% of deal value.

items.title: Dubai property deals hit Dh574bn in nine months; sales second-highest on record
items.summary: Dubai Land Department data show Dh574.1bn of real estate transactions across 165,018 deals in January–September 2026. Sales reached Dh379.4bn from 123,416 deals, the second-highest nine-month value on record, including Dh183.3bn off-plan. September sales totalled Dh29.7bn.

items.title: Abu Dhabi launches AI-driven platform for investing in government land and assets
items.summary: Abu Dhabi's Department of Municipalities and Transport unveiled the Government Asset Investment Service on TAMM at LIVEX 2026. Investors can find government land and built assets, register interest, bid and sign contracts in one system, with AI matching and standardised contract and land-pricing terms.

items.title: Aldar and Arada agree Dh15bn partnership as Arada enters Abu Dhabi
items.summary: Aldar and Sharjah-based Arada agreed projects with a combined value of about Dh15bn ($4bn). A joint venture will masterplan a mixed-use community of up to 1.5m sq m at Seih Sdeirah on the Abu Dhabi–Dubai border, and Arada is buying three Yas Island plots totalling more than 27,500 sq m.

items.title: TARAF and Mubadala sign MoU for 5.4m sq ft waterfront scheme on Al Reem Island
items.summary: Yas Holding's TARAF signed an MoU with Mubadala at LIVEX 2026 to assess a mixed-use waterfront development across 10 plots on Al Reem Island. The plan covers about 655,000 sq ft of land and 5.4m sq ft of GFA for apartments, offices, retail and dining. No value or timeline was disclosed.

items.title: Only 6% of Dubai off-plan projects have cut prices by 5% or more since February
items.summary: fäm Properties analysis finds 44 of 717 off-plan projects launched since July 2023 have cut prices by 5% or more since February, and just 28 sell below launch price. Developer apartment sales fell 6% to 62,147 in the first eight months of 2026, while studio sales rose 26%.

items.title: JD.com property arm to build 150,000 sq m logistics hub at KEZAD Abu Dhabi
items.summary: Jingdong Property, JD.com's infrastructure arm, will develop a 150,000 sq m automated logistics complex at KEZAD Al Ma'mourah with Khalifa Economic Zones Abu Dhabi. Completion is expected in 2028, creating about 1,000 direct jobs. The investment value was not disclosed.

items.title: Sobha Realty commits $600m to build 700 homes in Texas over five years
items.summary: Dubai-based Sobha Realty will invest $600m to build about 700 single-family homes on 260 acres in Celina and Frisco, north of Dallas, priced $1m–$1.5m. A first phase of 34 homes starts sales next year, funded by Bank7 and CCB loans plus equity. Houston, Austin, Nashville, Phoenix and Australia are next.

items.title: Dubai logs 335 home sales above $10m in first eight months; Palm Jumeirah leads
items.summary: fäm Properties' analysis of DLD data shows 206 villa sales worth Dh11.7bn and 129 apartment sales worth Dh8.67bn at or above Dh36.7m in Jan–Aug 2026. Palm Jumeirah led apartments (35 deals, Dh62.2m average); the top villa sale was Dh350m at La Mer and the top apartment Dh422m at Aman Residences.

items.title: Ohana breaks ground on Dh15bn Manchester City Yas Residences at Yas Canal
items.summary: Ohana Development has started work on the Dh15bn ($4.08bn) Manchester City Yas Residences, the club's first branded homes worldwide. The 1.67m sq m Yas Canal site will hold 2,000-plus villas, townhouses and apartments plus a football academy and marina club, built in phases to 2029 by Ohana's own contractor.

items.title: UBS puts Dubai fourth for housing bubble risk but says buying still beats renting
items.summary: UBS's Global Real Estate Bubble Index scores Dubai 1.16 (from 1.09), fourth of 23 cities and in the 'elevated risk' band with Miami, Seoul, Geneva and Lisbon. Real prices rose 0.4% in Q2 while real rents fell 4%; a skilled worker needs five years' income for a 60 sq m flat, against 11 in London and 15 in Hong Kong.

items.title: Dubai Cassation Court voids developer mortgages where loan funds bypass escrow
items.summary: The Dubai Court of Cassation has ruled a bank's mortgage over a development project is void, even if granted in good faith, unless the loan was paid into the project escrow account under Law No. 8 of 2007. In a BSA Law case a Dh246m mortgage was cut to the Dh93m actually deposited, bolstering off-plan buyer protection.

items.title: Cosmo Developments launches Dh6bn 'The Wadi' community on Yas Canal
items.summary: Cosmo Developments, a Flag Holding–Reportage venture, has launched The Wadi, a Dh6bn community on a 140,700 sq m plot at Yas Canal, five minutes from Zayed International Airport. Plans cover 3,950 studio to three-bed apartments, a hotel, retail, sports facilities, a waterfront and yacht marina around a central valley.

items.title: Record Dh130m Sky Palace sale caps strong H1 for Ras Al Khaimah; apartment prices +18%
items.summary: CBRE's H1 2026 review records RAK's highest-ever home sale, a Dh130m ($35.4m) Sky Palace at Waldorf Astoria Residences. Apartment prices rose 18% year on year to Dh2,298/sq ft, villas 7.3% and apartment rents 14.3%, led by Al Marjan Island (+23.1%). Over 34,000 units are due by 2030, c.10,000 of them branded.

items.title: Aldar launches Yas Riva Reserve: 292 gated waterfront villas from Dh7.9m
items.summary: Aldar has unveiled Yas Riva Reserve on Yas Island's north-east waterfront: a gated community of 292 four- to six-bedroom villas, 45 of them on the water with optional private pontoons. Prices start at Dh7.9m and sales opened on 26 September; a new bridge will link the enclave to Yas Island.

items.title: Meraas awards Dh1bn contract for Nad Al Sheba Gardens Phase 7 villas
items.summary: Dubai Holding Real Estate's Meraas awarded GCC Contracting a near-Dh1bn contract for Phase 7 of Nad Al Sheba Gardens. The phase adds 272 homes: 130 villas of four to seven bedrooms and 142 three-bedroom townhouses, with completion targeted for Q2 2028.

items.title: Qatar lines up $61bn infrastructure and real estate pipeline over five years
items.summary: Qatar expects to award about $38.5bn of infrastructure projects, including PPPs, over the next five years, plus a $22.5bn real estate and hospitality pipeline for private investors. It also set up Doha Investment, a platform to manage QIA's domestic portfolio and attract foreign capital.

items.title: Eagle Hills signs $12bn deal for Maldives Waterfront and Marina at Ras Male
items.summary: Abu Dhabi's Eagle Hills, chaired by Mohamed Alabbar, signed a $12bn agreement with the Maldives government to develop Ras Male on about 1,100 hectares of reclaimed land, 17 minutes from Male. Plans include around 65,000 homes, hotels, branded residences and a marina, with 54,000+ jobs and 99-year leaseholds.

items.title: ROSHN and TMG Saudi ink preliminary deal for 55,000-home Riyadh project
items.summary: PIF-owned ROSHN and TMG Saudi signed a preliminary agreement for a mixed-use Riyadh community of more than 55,000 homes, following a June 2026 MoU. TMG Saudi will hold 51% and ROSHN 49%; the scheme includes retail, hospitality, healthcare and education. Value and timeline were not disclosed.

items.title: Aldar-Mubadala JV buys Masdar City Square for Dh918m
items.summary: The Aldar-Mubadala joint venture acquired Masdar City Square, a commercial complex in Abu Dhabi, for Dh918m ($250m). The deal lifts the JV's Masdar City portfolio of commercial and residential income-producing assets to about Dh4.7bn.

items.title: Dubai Holding awards Dh5bn contracts for new HQ and Jumeirah Residences Emirates Towers
items.summary: Dubai Holding awarded China State Construction (CSCEC ME) Dh5bn of contracts for its SOM-designed circular headquarters, due 2029, and Jumeirah Residences Emirates Towers. The latter comprises 754 branded residences across two SCDA-designed towers, with handover scheduled for 2030.

items.title: Dubai home values slip 3.1% year-on-year in August as sales volumes cool
items.summary: ValuStrat's index fell 0.2% in August to 218.8 points, down 3.1% annually and 10.2% below February's peak. Villas dipped 1.7% year-on-year, the first annual fall since 2021, while apartments eased 5.3%. Ready sales fell 20.6% and off-plan registrations 40.4% year-on-year.

items.title: PIF launches Gulf Coast Development Company for 20 sq km Al-Khafji destination
items.summary: PIF set up Gulf Coast Development Company to build an integrated coastal destination in Al-Khafji, Eastern Province, spanning about 20 sq km with a 10 km Gulf waterfront. Plans include eight neighbourhoods with 16,000+ homes, roughly 1,400 hotel rooms and marinas; phase one is due in 2030.
